decisions.reason: As a core safety-footwear line that moved from a simple mention to its own page, it fits the firm's existing knowledge base and shows enough traction to justify continued refinement rather than withdrawal.

The comfort insole is closely related to the firm's work-shoe capabilities, but its flat website visibility suggests only moderate market pull, so it is kept with some risk of later portfolio pruning.

The supportive insole also builds on familiar footwear know-how, yet limited prominence and overlap with other insole offers raise the chance of rationalisation even though it remains worth keeping for now.
An ergonomic safety-shoe series sits squarely in the firm's established competence set and sustained dedicated-page treatment indicates strong enough demand and learning potential to keep it.
Firefighter and rescue boots are adjacent to the firm's protective-footwear expertise, and their upgrade to a dedicated page signals successful assimilation of this niche and supports retention.
The moulded insole has the strongest market signal, including homepage placement and a cited customer application, so the firm is likely to build further on this highly related and learnable offer.
